toxicities: Prominent drowsiness/somnolence, dizziness, blurred vision, confusion or disorientation, incoordination, extrapyramidal reactions, hallucinations, and seizures are reported.
Respiratory depression and apnea can be potentially fatal; neuroleptic malignant syndrome has also been reported.
Overdose can cause central nervous system and cardiovascular depression, profound hypotension, respiratory depression, unconsciousness, and sudden death.
